description.en:
The type of the client.

Valid values:

*   1: hardware client.
*   2: software client.
The IDs of the devices. You can specify up to 200 IDs.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the regions supported by WUYING Workspace.

descriptions.zh: 每个设备只能注册在一个阿里云账号下。若尝试注册的设备已经被其他阿里云账号注册，则会报错。
descriptions.en: Each device can be registered in only one Alibaba Cloud account. If you register a device that has been registered in another Alibaba Cloud account, an error is reported.
